sourceEvidence.title: Engineering Leader
sourceEvidence.quote:
- Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team focused on design, tooling, process development, and production support for wire harness assemblies.
- Serve as the primary technical liaison with customers—conducting design reviews, supporting product feasibility, and resolving technical issues.
- Partner with Quoting team to own any won bids and manage the NPI process for new business, including material, labor, tooling, and overhead.
- Oversee the creation and accuracy of technical documentation such as harness drawings, BOMs, and work instructions.
- Drive product and process improvements to enhance manufacturability, reduce cost, and improve quality.
- Support the successful launch of new programs including PPAP validation and submission, documentation, and customer approvals.
- Troubleshoot production issues and lead root cause and corrective action initiatives.
- Manage engineering change requests and ensure timely and accurate implementation.
